title: Review of pcell contained heredity (S,I,W,D,H): containment replicates on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (every cell >= 31x at every check, 93-94% of particles inside), gate-off kills all cells, lowered-D twin coarsens; selection replicates (Supported)
summary: Looked at W/containment.png, the lowD particles view and sel_vs_marker.png. The world is identical to 20261025T0820-c06-pcell-multilevel-claim, so my labkit run of it on fresh seed 5 (rerun/seed5, T=100000: 20 persistent splits, generation 3) and my genealogies on seeds 5 and 6 (selection_review.txt, from my review of that claim) are re-runs of this world. New here: the author's contain.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (T=20000): every cell holds its particles at >= 59x (seed 5) and >= 31x (seed 6) the density 2-6 px outside at all 77 checks (median effectively infinite, the shell is empty), 93-94% of particles inside cells, 17 -> 25 cells. Gate off (gate=0, seed 5): no cells at t=2000. Lowered-D twin (W/world_lowD.py, seed 5): contrast 5-43x but the cells coarsen 15 -> 9. Selection on fresh seeds (selection_review.txt): death yield percentile 0.026 and 0.044 (marker 0.69, 0.42), parent-daughter r 0.84 and 0.88, and dying cells are already low 5000 t before death (0.15, 0.14).

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: uniform particle soup, no planted cells
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=4000-100000: discrete bounded walled cells
observations.W: W/c_world_s5.json, W/c_world_s6.json: min over 77 checks 59x and 31x, all cells >= 2x, 93-94% of particles inside
observations.D: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 20 persistent splits, generation 3; data in selection_review.txt: 27-28 genealogy splits
observations.H: selection_review.txt: death percentile 0.026/0.044 vs marker 0.69/0.42; r 0.84/0.88; lag 5000: 0.15/0.14

controls_run.W: W/c_gate0_s5.json (gate off: 0 cells by t=2000) and W/c_lowD_s5.json (gate off, DK/10: 5-43x but 15 -> 9 cells)
controls_run.H: inert marker in the same runs (selection_review.txt)

verdicts.limitation: The particles are held by a reflection (acceptance) rule, so containment is a property of the gate rather than of diffusion through a membrane; without the gate there are no cells at all, so W and I are not separable by that ablation. H keeps the multilevel claim's limits: continuous trait, no clear population-mean response.
